title: Beat Bloom
description: Hit the beat on a neon 3D highway to 52 songs: 20 originals plus famous tunes like Für Elise, Canon in D, Ode to Joy, Jingle Bells and Flight of the Bumblebee. 8 songs are free from the start; earn stars to unlock the rest. Tap the lanes or use D F J K, hold long notes, chain combos and watch your live rank on each song's leaderboard, from Easy to six-lane Extreme.
